title: ML Compass: Navigating Capability, Cost, and Compliance Trade-offs in AI Model Deployment
reasoning: The paper develops a framework (ML Compass) that incorporates 'values' and 'safety' as key capability dimensions. It utilizes the PRISM Alignment dataset, which evaluates models on 'value-laden topics' and explicitly identifies a 'Reflective Use' task category involving discussions of 'spiritual themes' and 'moral values'. It also segments users into an 'Ethics-focused' type.
